name: Fire29 rounded layered flame tips
description: User says: motion is now visible, BUT the fire at the edges looks FLAT. Keep the current motion excursion,32frames20fps and source tile. Give the rim flames rounded painterly VOLUME instead of flat triangular curtains. Break each broad edge sheet into2or3 SHORT overlapping irregular tongues, at different depths and phases. Each tongue has a darker translucent red/orange outer body, rich orange middle and a smaller warm pale-orange luminous inner core, plus soft textured transition between them; rounded flowing bulges rather than razor-flat ribbons or solid flat fill. Leave small dark/translucent valleys between overlapping tongues to read separate depth. Grow/recede the outer body and inner core together, attached to original burning streaks; do not slide the whole tongue. Keep source mottled hand-painted look. Especially the left/right rim: show a little front-facing flame body above the floor, not just a flat strip glued to the diagonal edge. Maintain low height roughly12to20 source pixels (6to10 at game scale), broad base, calm asynchronous growth and no flashes. At least two rim groups remain visibly burning throughout; avoid a lone narrow apex torch. Preserve original floor/cracks, texture-flow movement, steady brightness, palette and seamless join. No yellow bush crowns, repeated geometric symbols, tall jets, sparks, smoke, whole-shape bend or global pulses.
